bundle.shortDescription: Defensive security harness for your own SaaS
bundle.longDescription: Crenel hardens your own app: it scans what you declare you own, proves each finding with replayable evidence, and runs locally. This app is a window around the Crenel console; the engine runs on 127.0.0.1 only.
